description: List the recorded price changes of one plan in one region, newest first, with the previous and new local price. Use it for questions like "has ChatGPT Plus gotten more expensive in Brazil?".

channel.description: Sales channel: web (ChatGPT website checkout, ChatGPT only) or app_store (iOS in-app purchase). Defaults to web for ChatGPT and app_store for other products.

locale.description: Language for region and plan names: en (default) or zh.

plan.description: Plan key from list_catalog, e.g. plus, pro, business (ChatGPT), claude_pro, gemini_ai_pro, perplexity_pro, supergrok. Defaults to the product's main plan.

product.description: Product: chatgpt, claude, gemini, perplexity or grok.

region.description: Country or region as an ISO 3166 code (JP), English name (Japan) or Chinese name (日本).

name: get_price_history

changedAt.description: When AISub first recorded the new price; not necessarily when it took effect.

trackedSince.description: Earliest observation AISub retains for this series; no changes before it are known.

title: Price change history
